title: Capital deployment, operating profit and break-even capacity
prompt: All inputs are explicitly synthetic. Calculator or code use is permitted. Let A be continuously selectable AUM in USD million between0 and maximum_aum. Annual net profit in USD million for A>0 is (gross_alpha-linear_drag)*A-impact_coefficient*A^(3/2)-annual_fixed_cost. These numerical units are part of the model: impact_coefficient has units (USD million)^(-1/2) per year. Shutting down at A=0 earns zero and pays no fixed cost. Positive net return on AUM is net profit/A. Find the AUM maximizing dollar profit, its annual profit, the two positive break-even AUM values delimiting strictly positive operating profit, and the AUM maximizing net return on AUM over positive operating sizes. No financing, taxes or costs beyond this formula. At equal dollar profit prefer shutdown.

outputs.name: profit_maximizing_aum
outputs.description: AUM maximizing annual net dollar profit.

outputs.name: positive_break_even_aum
outputs.description: [lower,upper]; strictly positive operating profit occurs between them.
